title: Best-Execution NBBO Recompute
description: Recomputes, per supplied fill, price improvement in basis points against the NBBO at time of execution and whether each fill cleared at-or-better than the NBBO. Aggregates pct_at_or_better, avg_price_improvement_bps, and fill_count over a bounded fill set (capped at 5,000 fills). Zero PII. Client-side. Works offline.
regulation: Reg NMS best-execution obligations (17 CFR 242) and FINRA Rule 5310. The core recompute is a generic shape any best-execution regime ultimately checks, not a jurisdiction-specific determination.

mcp_tool_definition.name: recompute_best_execution
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recompute price improvement vs. NBBO for a bounded set of fills (max 5,000) and score pct_at_or_better + avg_price_improvement_bps. Caller-supplied fill data only: no live market-data fetch, no customer/order identifiers accepted. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/art-541-best-execution-recompute.html for interactive use.

fills.description: Fill set, max 5,000 entries. No customer/order identifiers.

nbbo_bid.description: NBBO bid at execution time (required for sell fills)

nbbo_ask.description: NBBO ask at execution time (required for buy fills)
